families.family: Exclusion from markets: labour, informality and workers' rights
families.definition: Barriers that keep group members out of, or unprotected in, labour and other markets: discrimination, care burdens, informality of work, labour contracts and rights. Holds the worker side of the formality split.
families.examples: Protect worker rights and labour standards · Reform labour market regulation · Expand care services

families.definition: Administrative, physical and informational barriers that keep group members from services and entitlements they are eligible for.
families.examples: Promote social inclusion · Strengthen disability inclusion · Expand legal identity and civil registration

families.family: Exclusion from social and political spaces
families.definition: Norms, under-representation and between-group inequality that restrict voice and standing of excluded groups.
families.examples: Advance gender equality · Preserve language and traditional knowledge

families.family: Violence, coercion and denial of dignity
families.definition: Violence and exploitation inside households and labour markets that strip rights and dignity from the most exposed groups.
families.examples: Strengthen child protection · Prevent gender-based violence · Strengthen social services

families.definition: Displacement by conflict, disaster, climate or projects, and integration of displaced people in host communities.
families.examples: Compensate and resettle affected communities · Support refugees, migrants and returnees

families.definition: Transfers, insurance and asset building that hold household consumption steady and lift households past poverty thresholds.
families.examples: Expand social protection coverage · Expand social assistance · Improve social protection delivery and targeting

families.definition: Household command over adequate, safe food and the nutrition that follows.
families.examples: Improve food security · Improve nutrition · Strengthen food safety and quality

families.definition: Crime and violence in public life and the deterrence, justice and rehabilitation channels that reduce them.
families.examples: Reform the justice sector · Strengthen law enforcement and policing · Expand access to justice

families.definition: First access to electricity, water, sanitation, clean cooking and adequate housing.
families.examples: Expand affordable housing · Expand access to basic services · Expand water and sanitation services

families.definition: Health service coverage and quality, and prevention of disease and injury.
families.examples: Improve transport safety · Expand access to health services · Build health workforce

families.definition: Knowledge and skills built through early childhood, school and university.
families.examples: Improve education quality · Reform education governance and management · Expand inclusive education

families.definition: Job-relevant skills formed after or alongside schooling, the signals that make them pay, and households' access to and use of digital connectivity.
families.examples: Build workforce skills · Strengthen technical and vocational education · Build digital skills and literacy

families.definition: Reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, and the adjustment of workers and places to decarbonisation.
families.examples: Expand renewable energy · Mobilise climate and environmental finance · Strengthen climate governance

families.family: Climate risk to assets and people
families.definition: Losses from climate hazards, and the location, protection and practice changes that reduce them.
families.examples: Build climate resilience and adaptation · Reduce disaster risk · Reduce flood risk

families.definition: Ecosystems, wild stocks and land as assets under common-pool and incentive problems.
families.examples: Conserve biodiversity and wildlife · Manage fisheries sustainably · Manage natural resources sustainably

families.definition: Allocation of scarce, variable and shared water.
families.examples: Manage water resources · Expand water storage and transfer · Improve water efficiency

families.definition: Local pollution and waste as drawdown of environmental sinks, with health and human-capital costs.
families.examples: Improve waste management · Control pollution · Promote cleaner production and sustainable consumption

families.family: Public wealth: resource rents and the balance sheet
families.definition: Exhaustible resource rents and the public balance sheet: whether rents are reinvested and whether debt and fiscal policy shift burdens onto future taxpayers.
families.examples: Strengthen mining and resource governance · Develop the mining sector · Expand fossil fuel exploration and production

families.definition: Fertility, ageing and lifecycle behaviour that change labour input, saving and care across generations.
families.examples: Manage population and demographic change · Expand reproductive health services · Expand elderly care

families.definition: Fixed, variable and time costs of trading and the terms of access to foreign markets.
families.examples: Facilitate trade · Expand and modernise ports and shipping · Improve logistics and freight

families.definition: Foreign visitor spending as a services export: spillovers, carrying capacity and shock exposure.
families.examples: Develop tourism · Diversify tourism markets and products · Promote sustainable tourism

families.definition: Learning, related diversification and reallocation toward new and upgraded traded products.
families.examples: Expand and diversify exports · Develop manufacturing industries · Develop creative and cultural industries

families.definition: Creation, appropriation and diffusion of knowledge, including university and sector research. Sector is a tag.
families.examples: Strengthen research and innovation · Strengthen research capacity and infrastructure · Develop the digital economy

families.definition: Inflows of foreign capital, know-how, value-chain links and diaspora networks.
families.examples: Attract investment · Improve the investment climate · Engage the diaspora

families.definition: Cost of moving goods, people and information within the country.
families.examples: Expand digital connectivity · Improve transport connectivity · Expand and modernise railways

families.definition: Reliability, pricing and market structure of power, water and other network utilities.
families.examples: Strengthen electricity grid and infrastructure · Reform transport markets and regulation · Reform energy pricing and subsidies

families.definition: Backward and forward links between firms and the clustering that lets them find each other.
families.examples: Develop agricultural and food value chains · Strengthen value chains and supply chains · Raise value addition

families.definition: Productivity of density and the congestion, land and housing costs that limit it.
families.examples: Strengthen urban planning · Improve urban mobility · Upgrade urban infrastructure and services

families.definition: Persistent spatial gaps between regions, and the place-based policies that try to close them.
families.examples: Promote local and regional economic development · Reduce regional disparities · Promote rural development

families.definition: Management, capital and entry constraints of small firms, including registration and licensing (business side of the formality split).
families.examples: Support enterprise development · Support entrepreneurs and startups · Promote entrepreneurship and business skills

families.family: Finance for small borrowers and savers
families.definition: Access to credit, savings and payments for households and small firms.
families.examples: Expand financial inclusion · Develop the financial sector · Expand enterprise finance

families.definition: Adoption, learning and allocation frictions in farming, livestock and fisheries.
families.examples: Develop fisheries and aquaculture · Expand and modernise irrigation · Modernise agriculture

families.definition: Transaction costs that keep smallholders and small firms out of markets, and collective arrangements that lower them.
families.examples: Improve agricultural market access · Develop cooperatives and the social economy · Strengthen producer organisations and cooperatives

families.definition: How workers left out of growth find jobs, and the wage rules that shape their earnings.
families.examples: Promote employment · Promote inclusive employment · Strengthen labour market institutions

families.definition: Concentrated shocks to local labour markets from trade and technology, and how displaced workers and places adjust.
families.examples: Promote local and regional economic development · Reduce regional disparities · Promote rural development

families.definition: International migration as access to higher-wage labour markets, and what it returns.
families.examples: Govern labour migration · Govern migration

families.definition: Competition, contract enforcement and state ownership rules that decide who captures returns, and the misallocation that follows when they favour some firms.
families.examples: Improve the business environment · Reform state-owned enterprises · Secure land and property rights

families.definition: Security, documentation and transferability of rights to land, and its redistribution.
families.examples: Secure land and property rights · Reform land administration · Implement agrarian reform

families.definition: Detection of natural, biological and external economic hazards and exposures before they escalate.
families.examples: Strengthen health emergency preparedness · Secure energy supply · Strengthen weather, climate and hydrological services

families.definition: Buffers, reserves and pre-arranged finance put in place before shocks.
families.examples: Strengthen disaster preparedness and response · Strengthen financial stability and supervision · Maintain macroeconomic stability

families.definition: Scenario and futures work that keeps strategic options open.
families.examples: none yet

families.definition: Development planning and coordination of complementary long-horizon investments.
families.examples: Strengthen development planning · Mainstream SDGs in planning

families.definition: Statistical capacity and data shared across agencies for decisions.
families.examples: Strengthen data and statistical systems · Strengthen environmental monitoring and data · Develop geospatial information

families.definition: Monitoring, evaluation and iterative problem-solving that trigger corrective action.
families.examples: Strengthen monitoring and evaluation

families.definition: Policy experimentation and diffusion of what works.
families.examples: none yet

families.definition: Keeping rules for data, cyber risk, digital markets and AI in step with technology.
families.examples: Strengthen cybersecurity and online safety · Strengthen digital governance and policy · Modernise legislation

families.definition: Citizen participation in policy and budget decisions as a feedback channel.
families.examples: Strengthen citizen participation

families.definition: Coordination across agencies and levels of government.
families.examples: Strengthen policy coordination · Strengthen intergovernmental coordination

families.definition: Delegated autonomy that lets managers act without waiting for approval.
families.examples: none yet

families.definition: The people, management, local tiers and regulators that decide whether policy is delivered.
families.examples: Strengthen sector governance and regulation · Strengthen environmental governance and compliance · Strengthen public administration

families.definition: Surge capacity, continuity and fast relief and reconstruction once a shock hits.
families.examples: Provide emergency and humanitarian relief · Support disaster recovery

families.definition: Raising revenue and making public money buy what it is meant to.
families.examples: Strengthen public financial management · Improve public investment management · Reform tax policy

families.definition: Digital systems and DPI that speed delivery and cut leakage.
families.examples: Digitise public services · Build digital public infrastructure

families.definition: Risk and crisis communication that keeps the public informed and engaged.
families.examples: Improve public communication and awareness

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Elections and parties as the channel through which citizens reward and punish government.
families.examples: Strengthen electoral governance

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Independent media, disclosure and the information environment.
families.examples: Develop the media sector · Protect media freedom · Expand public access to information

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Constraints on the executive by courts, legislatures and audit bodies.
families.examples: Combat corruption · Strengthen accountability and transparency · Protect human rights

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Coalitions and dialogue among state, business and labour that build and sustain reform.
families.examples: Engage the private sector

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Community monitoring of providers, community-driven development and civil society.
families.examples: Support youth development · Strengthen civil society · Strengthen community development

families.subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
families.definition: Polarisation, shared identity, reconciliation and trust that make cooperation possible.
families.examples: Promote social cohesion · Support peacebuilding and reconciliation · Prevent violence and conflict

levers.lever: Non-discrimination rules and their enforcement in hiring
levers.joins_when: it stops a group being treated worse by employers, lenders or providers because of who they are
levers.joins_not: the barrier is physical or administrative (goes to L3-004, L3-006) or inside the household (L3-002)

levers.lever: Childcare, elder care and care leave that free women's time
levers.joins_when: it provides or pays for care so that carers, mostly women, can take paid work
levers.joins_not: it is about women's rights or representation in general (L3-003) or household bargaining (L3-002)

levers.lever: Rules on hiring, dismissal and contract types
levers.joins_when: it changes how costly it is to hire or dismiss workers, or what contracts are allowed
levers.joins_not: it sets wages (L3-179) or lowers the cost of being formal (L3-180)

levers.lever: Lower taxes, simpler registration and visible benefits for formal work
levers.joins_when: it makes formal employment or formal self-employment cheaper or more attractive
levers.joins_not: it registers firms rather than workers (L3-168) or extends insurance to informal workers (L3-260)

levers.lever: Collective bargaining rights, labour standards and their enforcement
levers.joins_when: it strengthens workers' representation, rights or standards at work
levers.joins_not: it is only about safety inspection (L3-182) or wages (L3-179)

levers.lever: Workplace safety rules and inspection
levers.joins_when: it inspects or regulates safety and health at work
levers.joins_not: it is about labour rights in general (L3-181)

levers.lever: Contribution rules, subsidies and enrolment channels
levers.joins_when: it extends social insurance, pensions or health cover to workers outside formal employment
levers.joins_not: it covers the poor through assistance rather than insurance (F-06) or formalises work (L3-180)

levers.lever: Accessible buildings, transport, information and services
levers.joins_when: it removes physical, information or attitudinal barriers for people with disabilities or reduced mobility
levers.joins_not: it is a general service expansion with no access barrier named (the family) or anti-discrimination law (L3-001)

levers.lever: Civil registration, identity documents and one-stop registration
levers.joins_when: it registers people or issues the documents they need to claim services, rights or finance
levers.joins_not: it registers firms (L3-168) or builds a data system for the state (F-43)

levers.lever: Family support, parenting and household programmes
levers.joins_when: it works on relations and decisions inside the household: women's control of resources, family functioning
levers.joins_not: it is about care services (L3-005) or violence (L3-007)

levers.lever: Quotas, reserved seats and leadership programmes
levers.joins_when: it puts excluded groups into decision-making bodies or leadership
levers.joins_not: it is about attitudes in general with no decision-making role named (L3-013 or the family)

levers.lever: Policies that close gaps between identity groups
levers.joins_when: it names a gap between ethnic, religious or regional groups and acts to close it
levers.joins_not: it is about national identity (L3-014) or contact (L3-013)

levers.lever: Protection services, shelters, legal response and economic options
levers.joins_when: it prevents or responds to violence against women by partners
levers.joins_not: it concerns children (L3-008, L3-009, L3-010) or crime in general (F-08)

levers.lever: Income support and schooling that take children out of work
levers.joins_when: it reduces child labour or keeps children of poor households in school instead of work
levers.joins_not: it is general child protection (L3-010) or school access (L3-036)

levers.lever: Laws, incentives and schooling that delay marriage
levers.joins_when: it raises the age of marriage or keeps girls in school to that end
levers.joins_not: it is reproductive health in general (L3-100)

levers.lever: Child protection services, case management
levers.joins_when: it protects children from abuse, neglect or exploitation, or treats its effects
levers.joins_not: it is early-childhood education (L3-039) or child labour (L3-008)

levers.lever: Resettlement with livelihood restoration, compensation and housing
levers.joins_when: it resettles or compensates people displaced by projects, disasters or conflict
levers.joins_not: it supports voluntary migrants (L3-019) or refugees' work rights (L3-020)

levers.lever: Support for households to move or diversify when their place cannot
levers.joins_when: it helps people move away from environmental pressure or supports seasonal mobility
levers.joins_not: it moves assets out of hazard zones in place (L3-086) or resettles involuntarily (L3-018)

levers.lever: Work permits, services and integration programmes
levers.joins_when: it gives refugees or displaced foreigners access to work, services or integration
levers.joins_not: it is labour migration for earnings (F-36)

levers.lever: Insurance and income replacement in shocks
levers.joins_when: it pays out, insures or transfers when income falls, whether to hold consumption, stop distress sales or let households take productive risks
levers.joins_not: it is a standing pension (L3-025), health cover (L3-026) or the delivery system (L3-024) (L3-021); it is income replacement in general (L3-021) (L3-022); it only smooths consumption after the event (L3-021) (L3-023)

levers.lever: Registries, triggers and payment rails
levers.joins_when: it builds the system (registry, trigger, payment channel) that expands benefits fast in a crisis
levers.joins_not: it is emergency relief delivery itself (L3-244) or a transfer with no scaling mechanism (L3-021)

levers.lever: Pensions and old-age allowances
levers.joins_when: it provides, extends or reforms income in old age
levers.joins_not: it keeps older people working (L3-103) or provides care (L3-104)

levers.lever: Health insurance, fee exemptions and benefit packages
levers.joins_when: it covers or caps the cost of care to the patient
levers.joins_not: it expands the services themselves (L3-043) or insurance for informal workers specifically (L3-260)

levers.lever: Targeting systems, poverty registries and eligibility rules
levers.joins_when: it decides or improves who receives benefits: targeting, registries, eligibility
levers.joins_not: it is the scaling mechanism in a shock (L3-024) or the data system in general (F-43)

levers.lever: Unconditional cash transfers and allowances
levers.joins_when: it gives cash to poor households with no condition attached
levers.joins_not: it attaches schooling or health conditions (L3-030) or bundles assets and training (L3-029)

levers.lever: Graduation programmes
levers.joins_when: it hands over productive assets with support to move households out of poverty
levers.joins_not: it is cash alone (L3-028) or microcredit (L3-173)

levers.lever: Cash transfers conditioned on school attendance or health visits
levers.joins_when: it ties a transfer to schooling, health checks or nutrition of children
levers.joins_not: it is unconditional (L3-028) or a scholarship paid by the education system (L3-040)

levers.lever: Food access and food price measures
levers.joins_when: it secures households' access to food through income support, consumer prices, distribution or price stabilisation
levers.joins_not: it is about nutrition quality (L3-054), price stabilisation on its own (L3-055) or production (F-32) (L3-053); it holds strategic food stocks (L3-205) or supports farm prices (F-33) (L3-055)

levers.lever: Maternal and infant nutrition programmes, breastfeeding
levers.joins_when: it improves nutrition of mothers, infants and young children
levers.joins_not: it is school-age feeding (L3-058) or food safety (L3-056)

levers.lever: Food safety standards, inspection, certification and traceability
levers.joins_when: it controls the safety or standards of food along the chain
levers.joins_not: it is product quality for export in general (L3-114) or animal disease (L3-163)

levers.lever: Storage, cold chains and post-harvest handling
levers.joins_when: it cuts losses between harvest and market: storage, handling, cold chain
levers.joins_not: it is transport to market (L3-155) or processing industry (L3-151)

levers.lever: School meals
levers.joins_when: it feeds children at school
levers.joins_not: it is school health services (L3-042) or early nutrition (L3-054)

levers.lever: Policing, sanctions and their certainty
levers.joins_when: it raises the chance or cost of being caught: policing, courts, penalties
levers.joins_not: it changes offenders' choices through programmes (L3-064) or rehabilitation (L3-066)

levers.lever: Prevention programmes for at-risk people
levers.joins_when: it prevents violence or crime by changing the decisions and opportunities of people at risk
levers.joins_not: it is enforcement (L3-063) or health treatment of addiction (L3-050)

levers.lever: Legal aid, alternative dispute resolution, access to justice
levers.joins_when: it helps people resolve disputes or get legal help
levers.joins_not: it is commercial contract enforcement (L3-171) or court independence (L3-213)

levers.lever: Prisons, parole, rehabilitation and reintegration
levers.joins_when: it concerns custody, sentencing alternatives or reintegration of offenders
levers.joins_not: it is prevention before offending (L3-064)

levers.lever: Enforcement against trafficking, drug markets and organised crime
levers.joins_when: it targets organised or illicit markets: trafficking, smuggling, drug supply
levers.joins_not: it treats drug demand (L3-050, L3-064)

levers.lever: Household electrification and affordable connections
levers.joins_when: it connects or keeps households on electricity
levers.joins_not: it is supply reliability for firms (L3-146) or renewable generation (F-13)

levers.lever: Water supply and sanitation for households
levers.joins_when: it provides safe drinking water or sanitation to households or communities
levers.joins_not: it manages water resources (F-16) or monitors water quality for the environment (F-17)

levers.lever: Clean cooking fuels and stoves
levers.joins_when: it replaces polluting household cooking fuels or stoves
levers.joins_not: it is ambient air pollution (L3-081)

levers.lever: Housing upgrades, slum improvement, building standards for dwellings
levers.joins_when: it improves the quality or supply of homes for poor households
levers.joins_not: it is land-use rules (L3-144) or hazard-proofing (L3-087)

levers.lever: Build, staff and run facilities and services so
levers.joins_when: it adds or extends a health service, facility, clinic, referral line, outreach or package of care for a population or place
levers.joins_not: it is about who pays (L3-026), staff numbers (L3-045), medicines (L3-046), maternal care (L3-047) or one disease's control (L3-049)

levers.lever: Clinical guidelines, accreditation, supervision
levers.joins_when: it raises the quality of care given: standards, guidelines, accreditation, patient safety, provider effort
levers.joins_not: it expands reach (L3-043) or trains new staff (L3-045)

levers.lever: Train, recruit, deploy and retain health workers
levers.joins_when: it increases or redistributes doctors, nurses, health workers or volunteers
levers.joins_not: it is their clinical quality (L3-044)

levers.lever: Procurement, pricing, regulation and supply of medicines
levers.joins_when: it secures the supply, quality or affordability of medicines, vaccines or medical products
levers.joins_not: it is research into new medicines (L3-133) or emergency stockpiles (L3-205, L3-242)

levers.lever: Antenatal, delivery, newborn and child health programmes including
levers.joins_when: it is a maternal, newborn or child health package, including routine immunisation
levers.joins_not: it is disease control for the whole population (L3-049)

levers.lever: Health promotion, nutrition and exercise programmes, health literacy
levers.joins_when: it changes diet, activity or other non-addictive health behaviours, or promotes health
levers.joins_not: it targets tobacco, alcohol or drugs (L3-050) or mental health (L3-052)

levers.lever: Control of infectious diseases
levers.joins_when: it controls a communicable disease or antimicrobial resistance
levers.joins_not: it is surveillance and detection (L3-207) or routine child immunisation (L3-047)

levers.lever: Taxes, limits, treatment and control of tobacco, alcohol and drugs
levers.joins_when: it reduces use or harm from tobacco, alcohol or drugs
levers.joins_not: it is drug trafficking enforcement (L3-067)

levers.lever: Road and transport safety, injury prevention, emergency medical response
levers.joins_when: it prevents injuries, especially road accidents, or treats them
levers.joins_not: it builds transport infrastructure for its own sake (F-25)

levers.lever: Mental health services, counselling, suicide prevention
levers.joins_when: it provides or improves mental health care or psychosocial support
levers.joins_not: it is addiction (L3-050)

levers.lever: Build schools and places, keep children enrolled, prevent dropout
levers.joins_when: it adds school places or keeps children enrolled and in school
levers.joins_not: it lowers fees or pays stipends (L3-040) or changes what is learned (L3-037)

levers.lever: Curriculum, pedagogy, assessment and learning standards
levers.joins_when: it changes what or how children learn: curriculum, teaching methods, assessment
levers.joins_not: it is teachers' recruitment or pay (L3-038) or vocational content (F-12)

levers.lever: Teacher recruitment, training, pay, incentives and accountability
levers.joins_when: it concerns teachers: their training, supply, pay, incentives or accountability
levers.joins_not: it is the curriculum they teach (L3-037)

levers.lever: Early childhood development centres, pre-school, parenting support
levers.joins_when: it serves children before school age: centres, pre-school, caregivers
levers.joins_not: it is childcare to free parents' time (L3-005) or infant nutrition (L3-054)

levers.lever: Scholarships, fee abolition, stipends and student loans
levers.joins_when: it lowers the cost of schooling to the household
levers.joins_not: it is a conditional cash transfer run by welfare (L3-030)

levers.lever: School health, sanitation and nutrition services
levers.joins_when: it provides health, sanitation or nutrition at school
levers.joins_not: it is school meals alone (L3-058)

levers.lever: Universities, tertiary quality, research skills and institutional
levers.joins_when: it expands or improves higher education or research training
levers.joins_not: it is university-industry transfer (L3-132) or vocational training (L3-032)

levers.lever: Vocational and technical training institutions and programmes
levers.joins_when: it trains people for work in institutions or courses
levers.joins_not: it places learners with employers (L3-033) or certifies skills (L3-034)

levers.lever: Apprenticeships, dual systems, internships, cooperative education
levers.joins_when: it puts learners in workplaces as part of training or eases the move from school to work
levers.joins_not: it is classroom training (L3-032)

levers.lever: Qualification frameworks, skills certification, occupational standards
levers.joins_when: it makes skills visible or comparable: standards, certification, workforce information systems
levers.joins_not: it builds the skills themselves (L3-032)

levers.lever: Digital skills training for workers, students and firms
levers.joins_when: it teaches digital skills
levers.joins_not: it provides connectivity or devices (L3-261)

levers.lever: Affordable connectivity, devices and public access points for households
levers.joins_when: it gives households or citizens internet access, devices or affordable connectivity
levers.joins_not: it serves firms (L3-140), delivers government services digitally (L3-227) or teaches skills (L3-035)

levers.lever: Carbon pricing, emissions trading, carbon credits and offsets
levers.joins_when: it puts a price on emissions or builds a carbon market or credit scheme
levers.joins_not: it funds clean technology (L3-069) or sets efficiency standards (L3-071)

levers.lever: Clean technology support and deployment
levers.joins_when: it supports developing, adopting or deploying clean and low-carbon technology, from research incentives to building capacity at scale
levers.joins_not: it prices emissions (L3-068) or deploys at scale to bring costs down (L3-070) (L3-069); it funds research rather than deployment (L3-069) (L3-070)

levers.lever: Efficiency standards, labels, audits and conservation incentives
levers.joins_when: it cuts energy use through standards, labelling, audits, building codes or conservation campaigns
levers.joins_not: it prices energy or emissions (L3-068, L3-148)

levers.lever: Planning and investment rules that avoid new high-carbon infrastructure
levers.joins_when: it steers long-lived infrastructure or capital away from high-carbon forms, or retires it
levers.joins_not: it is efficiency of existing use (L3-071)

levers.lever: Transition support for workers, firms and places hit by decarbonisation
levers.joins_when: it supports workers, enterprises or regions that lose from the move away from fossil fuels or combustion engines
levers.joins_not: it supports the new industry itself (L3-069) or workers hit by trade or automation (F-35)

levers.lever: Hazard mapping, land-use zoning and relocation out of exposed areas
levers.joins_when: it keeps people and assets out of harm's way: zoning, hazard maps, relocation, coastal setbacks
levers.joins_not: it protects assets in place (L3-087) or uses ecosystems (L3-088)

levers.lever: Resilient building codes, protective works and hardened infrastructure
levers.joins_when: it strengthens buildings or infrastructure against hazards: standards, flood defences, resilient design
levers.joins_not: it relocates (L3-086) or restores ecosystems (L3-088)

levers.lever: Mangroves, wetlands, forests and other nature-based protection
levers.joins_when: it protects or restores ecosystems as a buffer against hazards
levers.joins_not: it conserves habitat for its own sake (L3-075, L3-078)

levers.lever: Climate-resilient farming practices, zoning of crops to suitability
levers.joins_when: it changes what or how producers grow or make to suit the climate
levers.joins_not: it is irrigation (L3-160) or general productivity (F-32)

levers.lever: Protection and recovery support aimed at poor households' assets
levers.joins_when: it names the poor's assets or recovery after disasters as the target
levers.joins_not: it is general relief (L3-244) or insurance (L3-021)

levers.lever: Community or co-management rules for shared resources
levers.joins_when: it sets rules or community institutions for a shared resource: fisheries, forests, pasture
